entries.description: Turns drawio XML into a deliverable that opens directly in a browser. Writes viewer HTML (.html; opening it redirects to draw.io) to out_path and, by default, also writes a rendered PNG (useful for checking the rendering). icon:// references are resolved to data URIs and embedded. Before generating, it checks the diagram labels against the text rules and generates nothing if there is a violation. The font and font size are checked against the theme declaration (theme, or the theme of the talk-dir that is an ancestor of the diagram), and the result is returned in data.theme.

out_path.description: Absolute path of the .html file to write the viewer HTML to (opening it redirects to draw.io). If omitted, only the URL is returned in data.url. Windows-style paths (C:\... / \\wsl.localhost\<distro>\...) are accepted and converted to an absolute path under /mnt/<drive>/ or inside WSL.

theme.description: Theme used to check the font and font size: `git+https://<host>/<owner>/<repo>.git#<tag>`, `file:<absolute path>`, or the absolute path of a talk-dir or a theme root. If omitted, the theme of the talk-dir is used when the diagram is under its `public/`; otherwise the built-in default (sans-serif) is used. When the diagram for a slide is placed outside the talk-dir, pass the absolute path of the talk-dir. Windows-style paths (C:\... / \\wsl.localhost\<distro>\...) are accepted and converted to an absolute path under /mnt/<drive>/ or inside WSL.

entries.description: Downloads the runtime dependencies pecotv uses (@slidev/cli / dom-to-pptx / @slidev/parser, etc.) and Playwright Chromium. Call it when slide_create / slide_convert / slide_sync fail with "runtime dependencies are not installed", or when drawio_export / slide_convert / drawio_create PNG output fails with "Playwright Chromium is not installed". The first run downloads about 600MB of runtime dependencies and about 120MB of Chromium, so it takes tens of seconds. If OS libraries needed to launch Chromium are missing, it installs them with apt-get where sudo is available, and otherwise returns the command to install them. It skips what is already installed, so it finishes quickly and is safe to call repeatedly.

entries.name: slide_page

entries.description: Syncs an existing talk-dir. A pre-migration talk-dir (one that holds a copy of the template; slide_dev and others stop with theme-none) is moved to a form that references the theme given by `theme`. Files that came from the template are deleted, and the work area (slides.md / pages/*.md / public/slides/) is kept. The deleted names are returned in data.migration.removed. A migrated talk-dir that references a theme (theme: in slides.md points to the theme in dependencies of package.json) fetches the theme at the version in the dependency and relinks node_modules, and aligns the generated files (vite.config.ts, start.mjs) with the current content of the plugin. Other files are left unchanged. To raise the theme version, rewrite the #<tag> of the dependency in package.json before calling. Returns the presentation categories (data.categories), the list of selectable layouts (data.layouts), and the lint result of the whole deck after the sync. A running slide_dev must be stopped with stop: true and started again.

dir.description: Absolute path of the talk-dir to sync. Relative paths are not accepted. Windows-style paths (C:\... / \\wsl.localhost\<distro>\...) are accepted and converted to an absolute path under /mnt/<drive>/ or inside WSL.

node_modules_only.description: Only relink node_modules. The theme in package.json is fetched first, then linked (no network access if it is already fetched). A migrated talk-dir that references a theme behaves the same even when this is omitted. The generated files (vite.config.ts, start.mjs) are also aligned with the current content of the plugin. Cannot be specified together with theme

theme.description: Theme the pre-migration talk-dir should reference: `git+https://<host>/<owner>/<repo>.git#<tag>` or `file:<absolute path>`. Required for a pre-migration talk-dir (one that holds a copy of the template). Not used for a migrated talk-dir
